content_data.meeting_title: Q3 Growth Strategy & AI Scaling Discussion
agenda_items: Deep dive into current AI model performance and optimization bottlenecks
Discussion on global expansion strategy for next period (APAC focus)
Open discussion on competitive landscape and emerging threats
Resource allocation for upcoming product roadmap initiatives
Review of recent market penetration metrics for new AI features
key_decisions: Allocate additional budget for market research in key APAC regions, starting next week.
Initiate preliminary discussions with three identified food-tech logistics providers for potential integration.
Prioritize AI model retraining with new global data sets within the next 3 weeks.
Form cross-functional task force to evaluate competitive AI offerings and present findings within one month.
action_items: CEO (Self): Schedule follow-up with Head of AI for model retraining plan and resource needs by end of week.
Head of Product: Refine product roadmap to align with global expansion goals and present next month.
CFO: Prepare budget allocation proposal for APAC market research by next meeting.
CTO: Conduct technical feasibility study for integrating with identified logistics partners, report back in one month.
Head of Growth: Develop detailed market entry strategy for APAC regions, presenting initial findings in 2 weeks.
